name: Lliçà de Vall (Spain)
description: White field with two dark blue horizontal stripes at the centre, each one sixth of the height and separated by the same space.
history: The flag was approved on 23 May 2001 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3405 of 8 June 2001; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, white, with two dark blue fesses each 1/6 of the height, separated by a space of the same thickness, at the centre.
